text: The gypsies' camp within a mile of the murder

text: Tuesday, when the gypsies were gone
When the traces of the gypsies' camp were found

text: Why was the horse led out of the stable instead of being harmed in it? — to hand him over to the gypsies
id: q.why_led_out=to hand him over to the gypsies
why: Gregory proposes that Simpson was leading the horse to the gypsies, in answer to Holmes's question about taking it out of the stable.

text: Did the gypsies who camped near the hollow have a hand in the affair?
why: A neutral question raised directly by Gregory's new element.

text: Did the gypsies who camped near the hollow have a hand in the affair? — they received the horse from Simpson by arrangement
id: q.gypsies_part=they received the horse from Simpson by arrangement
why: This is Gregory's stated hypothesis of an understanding between Simpson and the gypsies.

text: Did the gypsies who camped near the hollow have a hand in the affair? — they took the horse on their own account
id: q.gypsies_part=they took the horse on their own account
why: Wandering gypsies camped nearby who left the next day give a reader reason to consider this.

text: Did the gypsies who camped near the hollow have a hand in the affair? — no part; they simply moved on
id: q.gypsies_part=no part; they simply moved on
